text:
Claire Park: Heads-up  onboarding confusion: user ran `redwood login` which wrote ~/.redwood/token, then started the node quickstart and hit 401s. Node SDK only checked REDWOOD_API_KEY.

Diego Morales: Yep saw that earlier. Python/CLI pick up the file, node doesn't. First-run experience bad.

Sana Iyer: Proposed canonical precedence: 1) explicit creds passed to client, 2) REDWOOD_API_KEY (env), 3) REDWOOD_SERVICE_TOKEN (env, service-scoped), 4) REDWOOD_TOKEN_FILE (env path, default ~/.redwood/token), 5) OS keychain / secret stores. Keep REDWOOD_ORG / REDWOOD_PROJECT for routing only.

Jesse Martin: Agree. Small SDK UX asks: a) report credential_source in client.metadata, b) sample apps log credential source at startup, c) CLI exposes `redwood whoami --json` for quick debugging.

Claire Park: For rotation: gateway can send 401 with header `x-rw-auth-status: expired|revoked|invalid`. SDK behavior: if expired -> try next source once then emit `auth:expired` event and surface `no-valid-credentials` with a hint to run `redwood login` or set REDWOOD_API_KEY; if revoked/invalid -> fail fast.

Diego Morales: Also suggest a small boolean option `preferEnvInCI` to disable file fallback in CI. That avoids accidental local-mount reliance in containerized tests.

Sana Iyer: Security: telemetry about fallback should be opt-in, only send auth_source enum (env|file|keychain), never tokens. And SDK logs must mask tokens.

Jesse Martin: Implementation plan (node): add CredentialProvider chain with overridable order, `refreshOn401` flag, and events `auth:fallback` and `auth:expired`. Unit tests: precedence + simulate `x-rw-auth-status: expired` header. Integration: sample app uses whoami to assert credential_source.

Claire Park: Docs: update quickstart to say exactly: "If you used `redwood login` the CLI token file will be used; if you prefer env vars, set REDWOOD_API_KEY. Use `redwood whoami` to inspect effective creds." Also add migration note in console login UX.

Diego Morales: I'll add gateway header support. Ops note: ensure header is only returned for auth failures, not other 401s, to avoid leaking info.

Sana Iyer: I'll draft a one-pager spec and PR template for SDK changes. Keep names minimal: prefer REDWOOD_TOKEN_FILE over inventing new long env var.

ops-bot: Created issue RDW-10021: "SDK credential parity + whoami + auth header semantics" assigned to @Jesse Martin.

Jesse Martin: Taking RDW-10021. Plan: PR with node provider + sample updates by EOD Thursday, follow-up python after. Will include tests and sample whoami shim.

Claire Park: Thanks all. If we land this, should cut down onboarding/support noise.

Diego Morales: :thumbsup:
